requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Seoyoon, are you still at the office?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yeah ㅠㅠ The meeting hasn't ended. Jiu, did you already leave work?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "I just left. By the way, did the contract go well?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yeah, I signed it yesterday. It's really over now."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Wait, only three days left?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "I know, right ㅠㅠ There's so much to do."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Did you book a full-service moving company?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Nope lol, semi-packing. We're moving on Saturday, so I have to pack the stuff myself."}, {"id": 2, "text": "What about your cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "On Saturday I'm leaving Bori at a pet hotel. {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "After the move, rest a bit on Sunday. I want to see Bori too haha. Want to get brunch?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Sounds good! Hyejin unni said she'd come help me sort things out on Sunday."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh nice. Then Bori will be at the house that day too?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yeah, my older brother said he'd drop her off Sunday morning."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Good. Should I invite Subin too? ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "I asked, and Subin can't come on Sunday. Said they already have plans."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "That's too bad. Oh, how do you spell the new hire Chaeyul's English name? I need to send the calendar invite"}, {"id": 1, "text": "She said to write it as Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' lol"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Okay. What about the sofa? Bori always slept there, right"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Posted it on Karrot and someone got in touch right away. We agreed to meet tomorrow evening for a direct trade."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Oh that's fast. Seoyoon, you really treasured that sofa, didn't you?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yeah ㅠㅠ but the new place is cramped so there's no choice"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Did you get your deposit back from the old place? Let's have Chaeyul do it lol"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Right. They said the deposit goes back right after the inspection is done."}, {"id": 1, "text": "My older brother used to work at a moving company. Want me to ask him for tips?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh, really? Is he still doing it?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "No, he quit last year and now runs a café. But he'll still give you tips."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Thanks lol. Jiu, did you send the Monday meeting invite to Chaeyul too?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yeah, I just sent it. By the way, is Bori okay with riding in the car?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "She runs away the moment she sees the carrier lol, I have to lure her with treats"}]}
